conventions: Local frame rows: x radial outward at node i, y tangent at node i toward j, z = x cross y. Matrices are row-major. Global DOF order [ux, uy, uz, rx, ry, rz] at node i then node j. Flexibility is node j's with node i clamped. Consistent loads are equivalent nodal loads p (system load += p; true end forces K d - p).
status: candidate; independent of product code; no acceptance
